title: Text: DET Nick Castellanos ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: Watch me make them eat these words
You know I have no doubt
Blows my mind. Let the kid be. You’re expecting to go 1-1, waiting for that call, then they announce you as a third baseman

They don’t get it. They flick up all their prospects and wonder why all of us tear the league up as soon as we’re out of a uniform. Mr Horton said it the best. Now instead of showing up comfortable confident ready to ball it’s like first day of school having to learn a whole new lesson while adapting to pro pitching.
We’re ‘way, way off-the-record,’ Leyland style, OK
Because I have a lot of respect for Mr. Horton, more than anyone in that organization.
Yea all this is off the record. Not trying to start anything just talking you and I

These are just a few of the many pages of baseball documents he gave to me over the winter. It is a step-by-step guide to hitting and drills and mentality like you wouldn’t believe - you, personally, might, because you know him well - but this shit is profound
Look at the questions on that questionnaire. You don’t see anything about mechanics or launch angle or analytics. It’s about the person.
He’s even got it in Spanish, man. They don’t listen to him!
Their to busy chasing their tail looking for answers on the outside when the real answers come from within. Willie knows that.
What’s your e-mail? Bout to send this to you
